finding.impact: Apps & Features could expose duplicate 1.0.1/1.5.0 registrations and the stale uninstaller could target files shared with the current install.

rootCause.claim: Historical per-user installation state remained in HKCU when later all-users installation registered the same AppId in HKLM; Inno Setup therefore retained separate uninstall registration/log identities across install-mode history.
rootCause.evidence: Exact HKCU/HKLM same-AppId registrations and distinct unins000/unins001 pairs observed on the host.

guard.trackedInstalledReleaseAudit: tests/windows_installed_release_audit.ps1 delegates to the exact AppId registration guard; the historical local _verify helper is ignored/non-authoritative.

prevention: Use exact AppId/HKLM registration checks rather than DisplayName matching.
Run windows_install_registration_audit.ps1 after installed lifecycle/upgrade maintenance.

For a future Windows installer release that supports migration from historical per-user installs, explicitly remove/migrate the same-AppId HKCU legacy registration after verifying the current all-users registration.

authenticode.fact: The published Windows v1.5.0 installer is not Authenticode-signed.
authenticode.decision: Do not self-sign as a substitute for a publicly trusted publisher certificate; keep checksum/digest verification and record trusted code-signing as external distribution hardening.

alternateAdminInstallContext.fact: Current Inno Setup source uses PrivilegesRequired=admin together with DefaultDirName={localappdata}.
alternateAdminInstallContext.limitation: If a standard user supplies credentials for a different administrator at UAC, the per-user install directory may resolve under the elevated account context. This scenario is not validated by current project evidence.
alternateAdminInstallContext.decision: Do not re-architect immutable v1.5.0 during a host hygiene fix. Treat broad standard-user/alternate-admin installation support as a separate next-release architecture gate.

exactNextAction: Commit/push the install-registration guard/evidence change, require protected CI, merge, sync main, then run final authority/residue checks.
